name: Skitter-Kin & Rad-Scavengers
identity: Tunnelling rat-kin hordes with unstable rad-tech. Cheap, cowardly and slippery: once per round a unit scurries away after an enemy activation, and their weapon-teams roll the dice on overcharged guns that might explode.

rules.name: Scurry · Seething Swarm
rules.description: Scurry: once per round, after an enemy unit finishes an activation, one unengaged Skitter-Kin unit may make a free 3″ move (not toward the enemy that just activated). Skitter-Kin units may Fall Back without being Rattled. Seething Swarm: once per round, at the End of Round, one Class 1 [FRAIL] unit returns D3 slain models (never above Starting Strength).

rules.name: Gamble — More-More Rad-Power!
rules.description: When a unit with an [OVERLOAD] weapon is selected to Shoot, you may Overcharge: roll a D6 — 1 KABOOM: the unit suffers D3 Fatal Wounds and does not Shoot · 2–5: +1 to Wound and +1 Damage · 6: also +1 PEN and +2 Attacks. (Risk: durability (dice).)

detachments.name: Rad-Tech Clans
detachments.playstyle: Weapon-teams and engines overcharging every activation.

rules.name: Tinker-Tinker
rules.description: Overcharge rolls of 1 may be re-rolled once per round (army-wide); Weapon Teams within 3″ of a Class 1 unit are [UNSEEN 12″].

enhancements.name: Rad-Stone Amulet
enhancements.description: **Under-Chief Warlock-Engineer** only. Units within 6″ ignore Overcharge KABOOM on a 4+.

stratagems.name: Rad-Surge
stratagems.effect: Roll two dice and pick one.

stratagems.name: Duck Behind the Slaves
stratagems.turn: A Weapon Team is targeted within 3″ of a Class 1 unit
stratagems.effect: The Class 1 unit takes the attack instead.

stratagems.name: Burn-Out
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 3″ also suffers D3 Fatal Wounds.

detachments.name: Burrowing Swarm
detachments.playstyle: Hordes appearing from table edges and drills (no portals).

rules.name: Underhive Ambush
rules.description: Up to 3 Class 1 units may start in Reserves and arrive from Round 2 wholly within 6″ of any table edge or within 3″ of a friendly Subterranean Rad-Drill, more than 8″ from enemies.

enhancements.name: Tunnel-Map
enhancements.description: **Gutter-Assassin** only. One unit arriving from Reserves may arrive 6″ from enemies instead of 8″.

enhancements.name: Swarm-Master's Whip
enhancements.description: **Clan-Lord Clawmaster** only. Friendly Class 1 units within 6″ get +1 to Hit in melee.

stratagems.name: Endless Tide
stratagems.effect: Return a destroyed Class 1 [FRAIL] unit at half strength from a table edge.

stratagems.name: Scurry Away
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit finishes an activation
stratagems.effect: Scurry a second unit this round.

stratagems.name: Overwhelm
stratagems.turn: A unit with 10+ models declares a Charge

detachments.name: Skilled Manipulators
detachments.playstyle: Leaders hide behind the horde while it soaks the damage.

rules.name: Expendable Kin
rules.description: Leaders within 3″ of a friendly Class 1 unit have WARD 4+ against ranged attacks; any saved damage is inflicted on that Class 1 unit instead (1 Fatal Wound per save).

enhancements.name: Crown of the Gutter-King
enhancements.description: **Clan-Lord Clawmaster** only. The attached unit has UNYIELDING 6+.

stratagems.name: Sacrifice the Slaves
stratagems.turn: A Leader is targeted in melee within 3″ of a Class 1 unit
stratagems.effect: Remove D3 models from that unit: the Leader is −1 to be Hit.

stratagems.name: Kin-Shield
stratagems.turn: A Class 2–3 unit is targeted within 3″ of a Class 1 unit
